summary.text: Rylan Finzer is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 50 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Matthew Kishman.
Finzer is a business owner who previously sought the Democratic nomination for Ohio's 6th Congressional District.

paragraphs.text: Rylan Finzer's career experience includes owning his own business.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 50 on May 5, 2026, receiving 6,378 votes in an uncontested race.
Finzer ran for the Democratic nomination for U.S. House in Ohio's 6th Congressional District in 2024.
Michael Kripchak defeated him in both the March 19, 2024 special Democratic primary and the regular Democratic primary held the same day.
Finzer has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
